title: ML Interview & System Design Capstone
blurb: Turn the whole curriculum into interview readiness: ML system design cases, coding patterns, classical CS algorithms, rapid-fire breadth, deep derivations, and a portfolio capstone.

lecture.summary: Turn the whole curriculum into interview readiness — the ML system design framework, classic design cases (recommender, search & ads, fraud, LLM products), coding patterns, classical CS algorithms, rapid-fire breadth drills, deep derivations, and a portfolio capstone.
lecture.prereqs: The rest of the curriculum — this module is the integration test.
takeaways: ML system design has a repeatable framework: clarify, frame, data, features, model, serving, metrics, iteration.
Most interview questions trace back to a small set of derivations and trade-offs you can drill deliberately.
A portfolio project you can defend end-to-end beats a long list of frameworks on a resume.
